source._version_note: v13.0.2 is the LATEST grafana GA (gh api repos/grafana/grafana/releases/latest => v13.0.2, published 2026-06-09, prerelease=false; queue-latest-version policy). go.mod directive is `go 1.26.3`; builder is golang:1.26-bookworm with GOTOOLCHAIN=local (set by render_l009_kit) so the current 1.26 toolchain compiles, never a stale go.mod-pinned toolchain — building against the newer Go stdlib is the dominant stale-stdlib-in-binary CVE remediation. IMPORTANT VERSION-STAMP DETAIL: the ldflags var is `main.version` (pkg/cmd/grafana/main.go, default '9.2.0'), and the Makefile derives BUILD_VERSION from package.json's `version` field which is the BARE `13.0.2` (NO `v` prefix). So the stamp is -X main.version=13.0.2 (bare), and `grafana --version` / `grafana server -v` prints `grafana version 13.0.2`. The --depth-1 vendored tree has no git tag, but the version is package.json-derived not git-derived, so the bare stamp is exact. VERIFIED LIVE on <redacted: internal host>: `grafana version 13.0.2` (golang:1.26-bookworm, exit 0). | 2026-10-27 (retarget v13.3.0): v13.3.0's go.mod directive is `go 1.27.3`, so the builder moves to golang:1.27.3-bookworm (the toolchain follows upstream's go directive; GOTOOLCHAIN=local cannot build a newer directive). Its .nvmrc is v24.22.1 and package.json engines stay `>= 22 <25`, so node_version 24 is unchanged; corepack takes yarn from packageManager (yarn@4.18.1).

vendor_build._note: FILESYSTEM-asset materialization (NOT a go:embed). The backend `go build ./pkg/cmd/grafana` needs NO codegen (themes_generated.go is committed; embed.go only embeds cue.mod; pkg/services/frontend/index.go embeds committed *.html) — VERIFIED: a plain backend build with zero vendor_build produces a working binary. But the SERVER REFUSES TO BOOT without public/build (setting.go validateStaticRootPath os.Stat(StaticRootPath/build) fatal-errors if missing), so vendor_build exists solely to produce the frontend assets in-tree. Ordered: (1) `corepack enable` activates yarn@4.11.0 (package.json packageManager); (2) `yarn install --immutable` honors yarn.lock (3156 pkgs, +~390MiB node_modules, ~2min — VERIFIED exit 0 on <redacted: internal host> node:24-bookworm, only benign peer-dep/disabled-build-script warnings); (3) `yarn run build` = Makefile build-js target = two NODE_ENV=production webpack passes (`nx exec -- webpack --config scripts/webpack/webpack.prod.js` then `&& yarn build:react19` with --env react19=1), emitting public/build/ (the production bundle + assets-manifest.json that webassets.go reads). NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 caps the V8 heap so the webpack pass does not blow past <redacted: internal host>'s RAM+swap (the build is the heaviest in the fleet — see open risks). node_version 24 == .nvmrc v24.11.0 (engines `>= 22 <25`); `nodejs` in tooling triggers render_l009_kit's nodesource setup_24.x install + corepack. Do NOT add make/yarn/corepack to tooling beyond nodejs — render apt-installs git/ca-certs/curl/gnupg/make and node+corepack from the nodejs marker. After this, render runs `go get <dep_bumps> && go mod tidy -e && go mod vendor && rm -rf node_modules`; public/ (incl. public/build) is a main-module non-Go directory that go mod vendor does NOT touch and the `rm -rf node_modules` does NOT remove, so it survives into the offline build stage's /src and is COPY'd forward via offline_stage_copies. The offline `go build ./pkg/cmd/grafana` then compiles the now-frontend-complete tree with zero network. VERIFIED LIVE on <redacted: internal host>: yarn install + yarn run build -> public/build/assets-manifest.json present.

binaries_from_source.name: grafana
binaries_from_source._note: Single static binary. main_pkg is ./pkg/cmd/grafana (main.go builds the CLI: gcli.CLICommand(version) + commands.ServerCommand(...); the `grafana` binary subsumes grafana-server and grafana-cli, invoked as `grafana server`). The version var is `main.version` (pkg/cmd/grafana/main.go, default '9.2.0'); a plain build reports 9.2.0, so the offline stage stamps -X main.version=13.0.2 (BARE, no `v` — the Makefile derives BUILD_VERSION from package.json's bare `version`, NOT a git tag, so the --depth-1 tree's missing tag does not matter). The upstream Makefile also stamps main.commit/main.buildBranch/main.buildstamp from git, but those derive from git history the --depth-1 vendored tree lacks; we ship only the version stamp — `grafana --version` prints `grafana version 13.0.2`. NO build tags (default upstream build is tag-less; GO_BUILD_TAGS is empty by default). CGO_ENABLED=0 yields a static ELF (grafana uses the pure-Go modernc/mattn sqlite path only at runtime via go:build selection; CGO-free build is the upstream default static-linux recipe and the right shape for --network=none offline / non-root). out_path lands the binary at /usr/share/grafana/bin/grafana (GF_PATHS_HOME/bin) to match the official on-disk layout the entrypoint --homepath expects. VERIFIED LIVE on <redacted: internal host> (golang:1.26-bookworm): `go build -trimpath -ldflags '-s -w -X main.version=13.0.2' -o grafana ./pkg/cmd/grafana` exit 0, `grafana version 13.0.2`, 347MB binary.
